# Blog Post Outline: iPhone vs. Samsung Galaxy, Which Flagship Wins?

## 1. Introduction
- Why this comparison matters
- Quick overview of both models and who they target

## 2. Design and Build
- Materials, weight, and size
- Display quality (resolution, refresh rate, brightness)
- Durability and water resistance

## 3. Key Features
- Camera systems (main, zoom, low-light, video)
- Battery capacity and charging speeds
- Software extras (AI tools, customization)

## 4. Performance
- Processor and benchmark results
- Gaming and multitasking
- Thermal management and battery life in real use

## 5. User Experience
- Operating system: iOS vs. Android feel
- Ease of use and learning curve
- Ecosystem integration (watches, laptops, earbuds)
- Update and support policies

## 6. Price and Value
- Starting prices and storage tiers
- Trade-in deals and long-term value

## 7. Pros and Cons Summary
- Side-by-side table of strengths and weaknesses

## 8. Verdict
- Best for photographers, gamers, budget-conscious users, and ecosystem loyalists
- Final recommendation

## 9. Call to Action
- Invite readers to share their choice in the comments
